title: Exam moves up two days, onto the morning after a closing shift

life.summary: Community college sophomore taking nursing prerequisites, works about 20 hours a week as a restaurant server, lives with her parents 15 minutes from campus

known.fact: Needs about 6 hours of review for a chemistry exam; kept every block before midterm 1
Says she does badly on tests after less than 7 hours of sleep
Shift swaps go in the team chat and need 24 hours' notice and the manager's OK
Leaves home 30 minutes before an 8 AM class (15-minute drive plus parking)
Routine: studies at home in the afternoon, from after class until she leaves for work (about 12:30 to 4 PM); never after a shift and never before 8 AM
known.source: learned from 8 weeks of study blocks (kept 11 of 12 afternoon blocks, skipped both late-night ones)

attached.label: Professor: midterm 2 moves from Friday 11 AM to Wednesday 8 AM because of a conference

dev_must_notice.what: The chemistry midterm moved from Friday 11 AM to Wednesday 8 AM, so both review blocks now fall after the exam
Tuesday's closing shift ends at 11:30 PM and she has to leave at 7:30 AM for the exam: under 7 hours of sleep, the line she set for herself

Her only afternoon windows before the exam are today from 1:30 to 4 PM and Tuesday 12:30 to 4 PM: 6 hours, exactly what she needs. A swap of Tuesday's close needs 24 hours' notice, so it has to be asked before today's shift starts at 4:30

best_fix.what: Move the review into her own afternoon windows and say so with Undo: today 1:30 to 4:00 PM (with a break) and Tuesday 12:30 to 4:00 PM, 6 hours in all, and remove the blocks after the exam. Then ask once: want to try for a swap of Tuesday's close so she sleeps 7 hours? Here's a draft for the team chat; it has to go up before 4:30 today.
best_fix.why: Otherwise she finds out Tuesday that her plan prepares her for an exam that already happened. Both new blocks sit in the afternoon window she actually uses, so she'll keep them. Moving blocks is something Dev may do alone with Undo; the swap is her call.

must_not: Suggest reviewing after Tuesday's close or getting up early Wednesday to cram; she never studies after a shift or before 8 AM
Post the swap in the team chat or message the manager for her
Tell her to call in sick or skip the shift
Keep the old blocks after the exam, or put review time into Saturday's dinner with her cousin
Write practice answers, solve problems or check her chemistry work; plan the time only
assumptions: Restaurant swaps need 24 hours' notice (her own workplace rule, told Dev)
Professors sometimes move an exam to a special session with two days' notice
6 hours of review per chemistry exam is learned from her first midterm, not an average
